title: Geometric stalks of a constant etale sheaf
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $E$ an abelian group, and $\underline E$ the constant sheaf with value $E$ on the small etale site $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], i.e. the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the constant presheaf $U\mapsto E$ (all restriction maps the identity), an object of $\Ab(T_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]; write $\iota_U:E\to\underline E(U)$ for the component at $U$ of the canonical map from the constant presheaf to its sheafification. Let $\bar t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to T$ be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point] and $\underline E_{\bar t}$ the stalk [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Then the homomorphism $E\to\underline E_{\bar t}$ sending $e$ to the class of $\iota_T(e)$ at the pointed etale neighbourhood $(T,\bar t)$ is an isomorphism of abelian groups.

source.place: Lemma 03PT (2) (lemma-stalk-exact: $(\mathcal F^\#)_{\bar s}=\mathcal F_{\bar s}$ for a presheaf $\mathcal F$), with Definition 040R (definition-stalk: the stalk as a colimit over the filtered category of etale neighbourhoods, Lemma 03PQ cofinal-etale); the stalk of the constant presheaf is the colimit of a constant diagram over a connected (filtered, nonempty) index category

proof.text: Let Φ = pointSmallEtale t, U = Etale.mk (𝟙 T), and x the lift t. The upstream Point.presheafFiberConstIso E identifies the fibre of the constant presheaf with E. Its coprojection identity Point.toPresheafFiber_presheafFiberConstIso_hom shows, by composing with the inverse isomorphism, that the coprojection at (U,x) is precisely (Φ.presheafFiberConstIso E).inv. The upstream construction already supplies connectedness and the constant-colimit computation.

Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.Point.Skyscraper supplies the general instance IsIso (Φ.presheafFiber.map (toSheafify J P)), via W_isInvertedBy_presheafFiber and W_toSheafify, without a WEqualsLocallyBijective hypothesis. Apply it to P = (Functor.const T.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj E. Together with the inverse constant-presheaf fibre isomorphism, it makes their composite an isomorphism.

Point.toPresheafFiber_naturality rewrites this composite as toSheafify.app (op U) followed by the germ map of the constant sheaf. This is definitionally the morphism in the unchanged statement; rewrite by this equality and use the composite IsIso instance.

split_report.summary: Proof written from Stacks 03PT (2) and Definition 040R / Lemma 03PQ in three steps: (1) the stalk of $\underline E=P^\#$ is the stalk of the constant presheaf $P$ via $\iota$ (new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-geometric-stalk, Point.presheafToSheafCompSheafFiberIso specialized to pointSmallEtale; no such node existed: grep of dag/nodes for 03PT/sheafification/stalk found only users); (2) $P_{\bar t}$ is the colimit of the constant diagram $E$ over the nonempty filtered, hence connected, $\mathcal N_{\bar t}^{\mathrm{op}}$, so every coprojection is an isomorphism (new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-colimit-constant-connected-diagram, isColimitConstCocone); (3) the map of the statement is the composite, elementary. Added def-weil-pbc-pointed-etale-neighbourhoods to stmt_deps (the statement uses the neighbourhood $(T,\bar t)$). Lean: the source repository's CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.Point.sheafFiberConstantSheafIso (WeilConjectures/Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Sites/Point/ConstantSheaf.lean:81-85, sorry-free in the sorry map; reaches presheafFiberConstIso :43, isIso_presheafFiber_map_toSheafify_const :76) applied to Φ = pointSmallEtale t̄ and A = AddCommGrpCat.{u} gives an isomorphism $\underline E_{\bar t}\cong E$ whose inverse is the node's map, by toPresheafFiber_presheafFiberConstIso_hom (:48, at the element (T, t̄)) and Point.toPresheafFiber_naturality (Mathlib Point/Basic.lean:131): a two-line bridge, so an attachment candidate for the lead to verify rather than a literal statement of the node.
